ipeds.title: IPEDS via NCES College Navigator: student-to-faculty ratio and calendar (IC2024), fall 2024 admissions summary

stats.notes: CDS C1 fall 2024 first-year class: applicants = 15,130 men + 18,122 women + 98 another gender; admits = 13,821 + 16,929 + 92. Enrolled 5,543 is the full-time plus part-time total in C1 and B1 (2,578+34 men, 2,875+37 women, 19 another gender); C1's separate enrolled-by-gender lines add to a lower 4,655, an inconsistency in the CSUN file. CSUN left the C1 residency breakdown (in-state, out-of-state, international) blank, so international applicants and admits are null; 125 first-time first-year students and 950 degree-seeking undergraduates were nonresidents (B2). SAT/ACT score ranges (C9) are blank and the C7 factor check boxes could not be read reliably, so scores and factors are omitted. CSU campuses are test-blind. College Navigator (IPEDS) shows 33,005 applicants and 93% admitted for fall 2024.
